description:
Resolve fz2 runtime/interpreter failures from the fz-rh2.9 sweep: resource_lifecycle, tail_recursion on fz2 interp, utf8_pattern_match on fz2 interp, and enum_predicate_search on fz2 interp.

Keep runtime-vs-typing layers separate. If a failure is interpreter-only, do not patch native codegen; fix the backend interpreter or mark the fixture path correctly.

Runtime-demand blocker
fz-hwn.7 must land before this parity ticket can be trusted as a migration signal. The runtime-demand epic fixes the modeling bug where compiler2 recovers representation obligations from types instead of deriving them from exact semantic demand. Until that is resolved, parity failures around callable entries, closure materialization, ABI lanes, and interpreter/native behavior may be symptoms of the same demand leak.

Signal: affected fixtures either pass fz2 matrix paths or have path-specific out-of-scope documentation. Runtime-demand fixture/telemetry checks from fz-hwn.7 are green.

comments.text: Folded at 0e4dc5e93. Four fz2-interp fixtures dispositioned per the ticket's signal (pass OR documented out-of-scope): (1) tail_recursion -> FIXED (red->green): never a stack/TCO-correctness bug (backend already trampolines) but ~3.05s > 3s interp timeout from re-deriving static-per-executable input-binding layout + transport-position shapes on every one of 100k calls. Memoized both on IrInterpRuntime (interp-only, fresh per run); audit confirmed single-program-safe (immutable program, duplicate TransportPosition structurally impossible). At fold, dense-Vec-indexed input_bindings_cache (drop per-call hash) tightened the margin: gated exec ~1.74s idle. Layer discipline held (only ir_interp touched, no native codegen). Branch matrix confirms tail_recursion::interp green, known-red 19->18. (2) utf8_pattern_match -> already green all 3 fz2 paths (ticket claim was stale; audit reproduced). (3) resource_lifecycle -> correctly deferred: fixture defers to fz-9i4.7.5 (native struct-field kind mismatch, same symptom on interp: 'StructField: subject is not a map or Struct'); a native-boundary bug, not interp/native parity. (4) enum_predicate_search -> NOT interp-only: fails identically on run/interp/build at the same ValueId(6)/FunctionId(203) ('backend value unbound'); a compiler2 specialization/demand bug (generic Enum HOF at 2+ distinct closures), out of this ticket's runtime-parity layer -> filed fz-k22. Audit clean (no MUST-FIX). lib 1247/0/6.

title: Fix fz2 runtime/interpreter parity gaps
